content: Hello! You're speaking with IT support. What can I help you with today?
Hi, I'm having trouble accessing the employee portal. I think I forgot my password.
No worries, we can get that reset. Could you please go to the portal login page and click on 'Forgot Password'?
I clicked it, and now it's asking for my company email.
Great, please enter your full company email address—make sure there are no typos.
Alright, I entered my email. It says a reset code will be sent.
Perfect. Once you receive the code in your inbox, enter it on the portal page and let me know when that's done.
Got the code, just entered it. It wants me to set a new password now.
Go ahead and create a secure new password. Remember to include a mix of letters, numbers, and a symbol.
Done! I was able to log in. Thanks for your help.
